explanation: Zero everywhere except at D2 in the last ~10 trials of the episode (about trial 90 onward) when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by the common transition; then it is about 10 if the D1 of that trial showed a reward and the agent has been choosing a2 for several trials, about 5 if the D1 showed no reward, and 0-1 right after a rare transition or a switch from a1. Before about trial 90, and after any a1 choice or any rare transition, it stays at 0.
